description: Figure 5(a) illustrates training loss curves as a function of training steps for multiple methods in a training-from-scratch setting. The x-axis is labeled “steps” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 40k steps with tick labels at regular 5k intervals (0, 5k, 10k, …, 40k). The y-axis is labeled “loss” on a linear scale, ranging roughly from about 1.0 up to about 3.0 with evenly spaced tick marks (approximately every 0.5). Five solid lines are shown with no visible point markers: a blue line (Vanilla) that starts near about 2.6 at step 0 and decreases to around 1.3 by ~40k steps; an orange line (SepLLM (n=64)) that begins around ~2.6 and declines to about ~1.25 by ~40k; a green line (SepLLM (n=128)) that starts near ~2.6 and ends near ~1.2 by ~40k; a red line (SepLLM (n=64, H/T)) that begins higher (around ~3.0) and decreases to roughly ~1.6 by ~40k; and a purple line (StrmLLM (n=64)) that starts around ~2.6 and declines to about ~1.2–1.25 by ~40k, with all curves showing a generally downward trajectory over steps.
